message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard trend is assessed over the 2018-2023 window. The Capacity Index starts at approximately 2,800 in 2018 and ends at approximately 2,500 in 2023. A net decline over the full review window maps to the decline response route.", "option_label": "Route the record to restoration capacity decline response review"}
